name: filesystem
description: Extended filesystem operations beyond Claude's built-in capabilities

steps: 1. Review and install an approved filesystem MCP server
2. Replace the command with its local executable
3. Replace '/path/to/allowed/directory' with the minimum required directories
4. Add the config to your Claude settings file

examples.description: Allow access to home directory and projects

notes: This server provides file operations with explicit directory sandboxing for security.
